note: Alberta Parks campground in open mixed forest along the Castle River in Castle Provincial Park: 20 km west of Pincher Creek on Hwy 507, 16 km south on Hwy 774, then 6 km west on an access road. Three loops; the North River and South River loops are nearest the river, behind trees on the bank. Bring drinking water; no firewood sold. Day-use area at the falls. --Claude
